From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Mutual action timeline: POC environment delivery and network checklist

Hi Paul / SRE team,

Thanks again for agreeing to run a short POC with Redwood. I attached a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP_v0.3) that we use to track deliverables and timelines. To keep the POC on the 4-week runway we recommended, I need confirmation on four environment items we put into the MAP:

1) Org setup: invite for a Healthlytics admin (company@healthlytics.com) to our customer org (we'll send the invite from console-admin@redwood.ai).
2) API keys: confirm whether you want short-lived scoped keys (recommended) or a long-lived key for the POC.
3) IP allowlist: please share the CIDR blocks we should add to the allowlist for the POC testing agents.
4) VPC peering: confirm if you'll own the peering request from your cloud console or want Redwood to initiate (we can generate the peering template).

Proposed (high-level) MAP timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): org invite + API key decision + exchange of IP ranges.
- Week 1: key provisioning, allowlist configured, initial token smoke tests.
- Week 2: VPC peering test (if needed) and workload ramp.
- Week 3: validation, eval scripts, and acceptance criteria signoff.

Can you confirm the IP ranges you plan to use and who on your side will take the peering ticket? I've attached the MAP and a compact network requirements YAML for your SRE to review. If it helps, we can run a 30m walkthrough later today.

Attachments: 2028-06-27_MAP_v0.3.pdf (MAP draft), network-requirements-htx.yaml (inbound/egress rules stub)

Best,
Ben Carter

Next steps:
1) Paul / Mara confirm the change window for the peering and who will submit the ticket.
2) Paul confirm the Healthlytics admin username we'll invite (so we send the invite to the right account).
3) Mara: quick review of network-requirements-htx.yaml and any changes you want us to include.

Paul / Mara — thanks for the fast replies. Mara, welcome — great to have SRE in the thread. A couple of operational items from our side so the MAP can move to signoff quickly: 

Acceptance criteria (to mark the POC "deployable"):
- Org invite accepted and Redwood console shows Healthlytics org (account id recorded).
- Scoped API key issued and verified in smoke test (token exchange + single request).
- IP allowlist updated on both sides (Healthlytics outbound and Redwood ingress) and smoke tests pass.
- VPC peering established and routes validated, or a documented fallback path if peering is blocked by change windows.

If all items above are met we’ll run the evaluation script during the joint validation window and record the metrics in the shared Drive doc. Once metrics meet the agreed thresholds in section 3.1 of the MAP (attached), we’ll convert this to a signed acceptance and issue the POC completion note.

DocuSign: I can send the finalized MAP for signature once you confirm the owners/dates above — would you prefer DocuSign or an internal signoff email?

Mara / Paul — any chance you have a preferred two-hour change window in the next 7 days for peering? If so we’ll block it on our calendar and have Hannah run the validation runbook.

Thanks — Marissa
